criteria.description: Wrappers are generated by a committed script for every element that exists — no hand-written .tsx.
Generated output is committed and CI asserts it is current: the markup gate's empty-set floor AND the CSS gate's orphan sweep, which is the union neither script has (see #123).
Regenerating from an unchanged manifest is byte-identical. Only achievable because #74 made the manifest deterministic — do not remove normalise-manifest.mjs.

No protected/private member becomes a prop. inheritedFrom is irrelevant: public inherited fields (value, label, name, required, disabled, description, errorMessage, invalid) MUST be props. The original 'and inheritedFrom-base' wording was wrong and would have stripped 8 of sk-form-input's 10.
sk-nav-pill's event reaches a React handler in a real render.
A form-associated wrapper submits inside a React <form>.
sk-card's slot is declared. Documentation-only: a lens proved zero type consequence.
Behaviour 15 has an id, a reachable subject and a mutation — FORKED on #75, the harness is browser-only.
The SSR/RSC decision is made and greppable in the emitted output.
packages/react is typechecked: typecheck-all.mjs picks up 3 projects, and a wrong prop and wrong ref type are red.
Per element, emitted props == public non-inherited manifest fields, with a non-empty floor.
No hand edits to generated output — hand-editing a generated file fails CI, demonstrated.
The generator runs in the node lane.
React is a devDependency of the fixture/wrapper package only. Green before and after — regression guard, not an achievement.
Both suite-budget.json ceilings re-checked against a CI run if the mutation or test set grew. The 10s/mutation slope is withdrawn; marginal mutation cost is ~3.4s.
Wrappers for all five elements, zero hand edits, --check green in CI.
Two runs byte-identical, asserted in the node lane. NOTE: already true before any code — asserts a property that holds, not one being fixed.
Hand-editing a generated file fails CI, demonstrated.
No protected or private member in any wrapper's public props, asserted against the manifest. Public inherited members are expected to appear; their absence is a failure.
THE MISSION'S HEADLINE. What the wrapper buys over React 19's native 16/16 support, with evidence, in a durable location, including @wc-toolkit/jsx-types. A negative answer is a valid pass.
sk-nav-pill's event reaches a React handler in a real render.
A form-associated wrapper submits inside a React <form>.
sk-card's slot resolved; manifest agrees with the element.
The SSR/RSC decision asserted by grep over generated output, not prose.
typecheck-all.mjs project list grows 2 -> 3; wrong prop and wrong ref both red in expect-error fixtures.
Per element, emitted props == public manifest fields (inherited included, protected/private excluded), as sets, non-empty floor where applicable.
Three independent counts agree: elements on disk -> manifest tagNames -> emitted files. Two readings of one predicate cannot disagree.

negative_invariants.description: No protected or private member appears as a prop in any generated wrapper. (Public inherited members are required to appear — see FR-004.)
No element with >=1 public field has an empty emitted prop set. sk-stub (0 members) is the only exemption.
The gate does not report green over an empty or single-element emitted set — the floor is a ratchet on a committed number, not length>0.
A generated file the generator no longer emits, left committed, fails the drift gate (git diff and per-file compare are both green on this case).
The output directory is git-tracked and not under any dist/ path.
Deleting fixtures/react-consumer's test file turns something red.
No /** */ above a public member in packages/elements/src contains squad-review narrative.
